rust_toolchain: rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28), same release settings for both controllers
scope: Synthetic local workloads and private fixture services; no live microphone, desktop actions, installed service mutation or paid API calls.

policy-before.scope:
Measure command policy in fresh processes, without a desktop or audio input.

Compare checkouts with --source /path/to/checkout/src. Each case reports wall
and CPU milliseconds per call, peak RSS, transient Python allocations, and a
result digest. RSS includes imports and fixture setup; allocations exclude
setup. Timings run without tracemalloc. These are policy microbenchmarks, not
speech latency, whole-app RAM, or gaming performance measurements.

queue-before.scope:
Measure registry memory while 16 fixture actions wait in the Rust controller.

Uses private test services, synthetic desktop entries and a fake volume tool.
No microphone, display, installed service or real application is controlled.
Pass --binary to compare an older controller. RSS/PSS are controller-only;
fixture processes and the Python harness are excluded.

controller-latency.scope: Paused controller only; consent off, no voice, desktop actions, or replay. 5 alternating fresh pairs; 200 status queries; one-second idle sample. Same compiler and release flags.
